The **Larry O’Brien Championship Trophy** is the championship [trophy](Trophy "Trophy") awarded annually by the [National Basketball Association](National_Basketball_Association "National Basketball Association") (NBA) to the [winner](List_of_NBA_champions "List of NBA champions") of the [NBA Finals](NBA_Finals "NBA Finals"). The trophy originally kept the [Walter A. Brown Trophy](Walter_A._Brown_Trophy "Walter A. Brown Trophy") name of its predecessor until being renamed in 1984.

Before joining the NBA, O'Brien was the [United States Postmaster General](United_States_Postmaster_General "United States Postmaster General") under President [Lyndon B. Johnson](Lyndon_B._Johnson "Lyndon B. Johnson") from 1965 to 1968.[[2]](Larry_O'Brien_Championship_Trophy#cite_note-2)

The [1982–83 76ers](1982%E2%80%9383_Philadelphia_76ers_season "1982–83 Philadelphia 76ers season") were the last team to win the Brown Trophy, sweeping the [Los Angeles Lakers](1982%E2%80%9383_Los_Angeles_Lakers_season "1982–83 Los Angeles Lakers season") in [1983](1983_NBA_Finals "1983 NBA Finals").
